Inventory of values the judges are told to CREATE: (1) job titles/candidate names/emails for the gate and every board protocol are judge-chosen and explicitly suffixed/unique: functional/prompt.md:11 'unique title (add a short suffix for this review)', :15 'Use your own new jobs and cards ... (suffix every title and name for this review)', :17 replays need 'a new unique name and email ... a new unique title'; polish/prompt.md:11,14; visual/prompt.md:11; gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 'unique title ... unique name, a unique email address'. J1/J2/J3 are new jobs, so no seeded card can pre-occupy them. (2) Fixed literal probe: polish/judge.toml:23 note 'Call back on Fri' (given as 'such as') -> grep of seed_data.json, hireops_rules.md, instruction.md and solution/app/public|src|server.js finds no occurrence; the reference's only placeholders are 'Reason for rejecting' (board.js:21,216), so no prefilled/placeholder text can masquerade as the typed note. (3) polish/judge.toml:50,59 'distinctive reply' values are judge-chosen. (4) T protocol adds Tomas's account email tomas.varga@candidates.example to the NEW job J2 (functional/prompt.md:39) with a fallback 'if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3'; the seed has Tomas only on JOB-DATA (APP-201), so hro_candidate_linked is graded on a card that cannot pre-exist, and is distinguishable from his seeded Data Analyst application by J2's unique title. (5) Grep of reference markup/JS for seed names, account emails, 'Strong systems', 'Platform Engineer', J1/J2 found nothing; only db.js:63 holds the public demo password. Seeded values the judge READS rather than creates are deliberate positives, not pre-satisfied probes: Z/hro_restart seeded PE order (APP-105,106,108 Applied; APP-103,104 Screen) and Noor note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (seed notes[0]) match the seed; hro_restart also requires the review's own jobs/cards/notes/messages/activity to survive restart, so a static seed display cannot pass. Lena's 1 unread = 3 APP-301 messages minus read_count 2; no other dimension signs in as Lena (polish/prompt.md:16 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation'; render gate 'do not open any conversation'), so it is not pre-consumed. Seed has no activity table entries and db.js creates an empty activity table, so hro_activity/hro_activity_refusals cannot be satisfied by pre-existing lines. No seeded drafts exist. Broken-app attempt: an app that ignores account-email linking still shows Tomas's seeded Data Analyst application; the criterion requires the card 'added with Tomas's account email' (the J2 card), so it is not pre-satisfied. A live-board-dead app cannot pass hro_live_board because Mei's newly added card has a review-unique name. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app keeping drafts server-side would carry polish's leftover Rafael drafts (hro_pol_session_resume) into the shared DB; functional's draft/compose rows use the brand-new J2 conversation and judge-typed text, so a leftover draft neither pre-satisfies nor wrongly fails them (functional, unlike polish, lacks a 'clear pre-existing box text' clause; noted only, outside this row). No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so the actual values a judge chooses are unmeasured, but uniqueness is instructed in every creating prompt; that is not required runtime evidence for this source-level row.
